Hi Samir — welcome and thanks for the trial sign-up. I’m Evelyn on the Redwood SDR team and happy to run a focused 30‑minute session to cover:

- latency/throughput for 16k-context scenarios
- quantization and cost trade-offs
- Dedicated vs Hosted for production SLAs

Two windows I have available tomorrow (PST):
- Thu 11/19 9:30–10:00am
- Thu 11/19 2:00–2:30pm

If neither of those work, here’s a short booking link: https://calendly.com/redwood-sdr/demo-30

Also looping Ben to support any procurement/timing questions.

Thanks —
Evelyn
